note: Every Accumulation hit uses its preceding 60 sessions as three consecutive 20-session chunks. Each chunk first fits a straight line to closes, excluding at most one close that deviates by 4% or more. Flat and Golden Flat require a low line slope plus tight remaining deviations. Golden thresholds are calibrated from BHEL's 20 sessions ending 2026-03-30 after excluding the 2026-03-04 shock. Quadratic regression is used only when the chunk is not Flat, to identify a Cup, directional drift, or inverted-U distribution.
